_meta.notes: Five activities + the implicit entry-toll fold per Q-TB-2 (toll fires on first transaction per visit; see VisitStateManager + BuySellCommon.charge_entry_toll_if_first_visit). Wave 10B.2.2 ships buy_merchandise + sell_merchandise as real handlers; persuade/solicit/locate/accept_shipping_contract ship as stubs returning 'not yet implemented' until Waves 10B.2.3 (persuade/solicit/locate) and 10B.2.4 (accept_shipping_contract) replace them. The original gdd §1.3.1 combined-mode buy_sell_merchandise is replaced by two activities per §3.1 (cleaner UI + diverging param schemas + diverging eligibility).

param_schema.loads_count: int (positive; <= merchant.loads_available, or 2× via monopolist bonus per §4.11)

activities.effect_summary: Buys loads_count of merchandise_type from merchant_id at the per-load price computed by MarketPriceResolver. Consumes merchant.loads_available. Inserts a cargo_holds row on the carrier (CargoHoldRepository.insert_purchase). Debits party wallet for purchase + labor + (first-of-visit) entry toll. Monopolist active character gets favor_for_buy = -1 and a 2× max_buyable cap.

param_schema.merchant_id: string (visible merchant whose merchandise_type matches the cargo)
param_schema.loads_to_sell: int (positive; <= cargo.loads_count for partial sells per §13.2)

activities.effect_summary: Sells loads_to_sell of cargo_hold_id's contents to merchant_id at the per-load price (must match merchandise_type). Deletes cargo row on full sell (CargoHoldRepository.delete_sold); decrements on partial (CargoHoldRepository.partial_sell). Credits party wallet net of labor + customs duty. Monopolist active character gets favor_for_sell = +1. Domain-owner exemption per §8.8 zeroes toll + customs + stabling.

param_schema.merchant_id: string (visible merchant whose merchandise_type changes on success)
param_schema.target_merchandise_type: string (the type they should start dealing in)
param_schema.direction: string ('buy' or 'sell' — controls demand modifier sign per §4.3)

activities.effect_summary: Reaction roll 2d6 + CHA mod + proficiency suite (Bribery / Diplomacy / Intimidation / Mystic Aura / Seduction) + signed demand modifier (+demand for sell, -demand for buy per RAW L711-712) + monopolist +3 (per RAW L713). Threshold 9 Common, 12 Precious. Success: merchant's merchandise_type updates. Failure: merchant DELETEd (transactional) or marked refused_at_calendar_day (promoted per §0.1.1). [WAVE-10B.2.3-STUB]

Ongoing 1-3 weeks (RAW); 1 hour of game time per day. At launch, assigns staggered becomes_visible_calendar_day to invisible merchants (half ceil → +7 day, quarter floor min 1 → +14, remainder → +21 per substrate process_solicitation). Reveals fire on schedule while the activity remains active; forfeiture rolls back unfired reveals (per §5 spec). [WAVE-10B.2.3-STUB]

param_schema.merchandise_type: string (the type the player is searching for)

activities.effect_summary: 1 hour of game time. Surfaces one invisible merchant carrying merchandise_type. Outcomes: visible match → no-op success; invisible match → reveal one (MerchantPoolRepository.process_locate); no match → fail with no_merchant_of_type. [WAVE-10B.2.3-STUB]

param_schema.carrier_id: string (draft_vehicle.id or ship.id with sufficient capacity)

activities.effect_summary: Accepts a fresh shipping-contract offer (rolled at market entry per ShippingContractOfferRoller, Wave 4). Inserts a shipping_contracts row (ShippingContractRepository.accept_contract) + linked cargo_holds row on the designated carrier (CargoHoldRepository.insert_shipping_contract_load). DELETEs the offer row. [WAVE-10B.2.4-STUB]
